answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities unprofitable. Each agent pays a non-refundable 50-credit tax before trading, like a river carving karst rock: slow and costly. A verifier checks the receipt and issues one credential per taxed identity. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5000 credits, but fakes earn nothing without a work history. An honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full share, crystal clear in the ledger, undiluted by unpaid copies.
